Type: geometric jacquard throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: modern, contemporary, mid-century modern
Materials: woven jacquard fabric with textured stitching
Colors: black, light dusty blue, charcoal grey, ivory
Shape: square, all-over mosaic of overlapping triangles and shards, plump, knife edges, medium size
Feel: bold, graphic, energetic
Goes with: grey or blue sofas, white walls, black accents; modern or contemporary living rooms

Type: vine pattern throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: woven jacquard fabric with raised texture
Colors: ivory, black
Shape: square, vertical winding leafy vines with bold leaves, knife edges, compact
Feel: graphic, natural, fresh
Goes with: white or cream sofas, black accents, light wood, plants; Scandinavian or modern rooms

Type: tufted woven cotton throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, modern, farmhouse
Materials: woven cotton, raised tufted loops, textured weave
Colors: black, white
Shape: square, horizontal bands of checks with rows of chunky black tufted blocks and a rope stitch line, knife edges, compact
Feel: tactile, graphic, cozy
Goes with: white or grey sofas, natural wood, black and white decor; bohemian or modern farmhouse rooms

Type: tufted diamond throw pillow

Feel: soft, relaxed, crafted
Goes with: white or navy sofas, light wood, blue accents; coastal or transitional rooms
